content:
alexcrichton opened PR #15037 from alexcrichton:delete-some-tests to bytecodealliance:main:

These tests are all duplicated in *.wast tests throughout our test suite:

  • component_model::async::smoke: in component-model/trap.wast
  • component_model::func::bools: component-model/types.wast, some new cases added
  • component_model::resources::mismatch_intrinsics: in component-model/resources.wast and resources/handle-table.wast
  • component_model::resources::active_borrows_at_end_of_call: in component-model/async/borrow-lend-async.wast and async/drop-cross-task-borrow.wast
  • func::call_wasm_to_wasm: in call.wast and many-results.wast
  • funcref::receive_null_funcref_from_wasm: in ref_null.wast
  • instance::initializes_linear_memory: in data.wast and memory_init.wast
  • linker::link_undefined: in imports.wast
  • threads::test_instantiate_shared_memory: in proposals/threads/memory.wast
  • threads::test_import_shared_memory: in proposals/threads/imports.wast

This also removes module::native_unwind::native_unwind_walks_nested_wasm_frames. It isn't covered by a wast test, but it's a word-for-word copy of native_backtrace::native_unwind_through_host_call, and its x86_64-only gate has been unnecessary since the macOS arm64 unwinding fix in #14303.
